features.title: Sell with confidence
features.body: Record cash and utang sales, review your cart, and keep a saved record of every transaction.

features.title: Know what is on your shelves
features.body: Organize products, scan barcodes, track stock movements, and spot items running low.

features.title: Keep your suki balances clear
features.body: Record customer utang and cash repayments with a history you can look back on.

features.title: See how your store is doing
features.body: Review sales, collections and daily cash closing, with reports you can export.

steps.title: Create your store
steps.body: Sign up as a store owner and start with the Free plan.

steps.title: Add your products
steps.body: Set your prices and opening stock, then organize your catalog.

steps.title: Make your first sale
steps.body: Choose cash or utang, review the total, and save your transaction.

faqs.question: Do I need to pay to get started?
faqs.answer: You can create your store on the Free plan. See the current plan allowances below or on the pricing page.

faqs.question: Can I record customer utang?
faqs.answer: Yes. Record utang sales, view customer balances, and save cash repayments with their history.

faqs.question: Does Sarisari work without internet?
faqs.answer: Sarisari needs an internet connection to load and save your store records.

faqs.question: How do Basic payments and renewals work?
faqs.answer: When online billing is available, choose Basic in your account and pay once using PayMongo QR Ph. Your subscription activates after verified payment. Each renewal needs a new payment.
